description_zh: 调用RunTriggerNode运行一个触发式节点
name: RunTriggerNode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the trigger node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 触发式节点的节点ID。您可参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html获取节点ID信息
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The 13-digit millisecond-level timestamp that specifies the scheduled time of the node task corresponding to the trigger node
parameters.help_zh: 触发式节点对应节点任务的13位的毫秒级定时时间戳
parameters.name: cycle_time

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the business date for the trigger node instance
parameters.help_zh: 触发式节点实例所在的业务日期时间戳
parameters.name: biz_date

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the trigger node belongs. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html to query the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 触发式节点所属的DataWorks工作空间ID。工作空间ID可参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html查询
parameters.name: app_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。

true：调用成功

false：调用失败
